notes: The first route stops at «حدثنا يونس»: the text writes the rest (Ibn Shihab onward) only in the Layth route after «وقال الليث», so the first route is not extended (rule 9)
The Layth route is the second isnad with the same narrative, so it is its own group (rule 4)
«عن حديث، عائشة» : «حديث» is a word, not a name; Aisha is the last link
The text ends mid-narrative, so the report has no separate closing remark; the Companion's account is the saying
